worldcombat.skill.zingzap.summary: Charges static while rushing the target and dumps it all on contact: the longer the run-up, the higher the power and the better the flinch. With arc chain on, the current jumps to the next foe beside the target.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.use.0: Take a run-up and land one high-charge blow
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.use.1: Stun a foe that charged you
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.use.2: Use the target to arc current into a second foe
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.description.0: The ram deals about %1$s damage, boosted by the charge built during the run-up: each block run adds %3$s, up to a maximum of %2$s. The target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.description.1: Rushes up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s block contact radius; a full run-up builds the most charge, and a hit shoves the target about 0.7 blocks along the dash.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.description.2: A hit has a %1$s flinch chance that rises the more charge was built; the target flinches for %2$s, which interrupts the action it is currently taking if that action can be interrupted and stops it from starting new moves or ordinary attacks.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.description.3: When arc chain is on, the current jumps from the impact to the nearest other foe within %1$s blocks; the arc settles at %2$s of the main hit and its flinch chance is only 60%% of the main hit's.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.overcharge.on: Overcharge on: a longer rush, a higher charge cap and faster build-up and a heavier hit, but a slower wind-up and cooldown and a worse overshoot when it misses.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.overcharge.off: Overcharge off: a short, quick ram with a faster wind-up and cooldown and a lower charge payoff, but more reliable.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.arcChain.on: Arc chain on: on contact the current jumps to the nearest other foe (settled at 50%% of the main hit, with a flinch chance 60%% of the main hit's), but the main hit is about 10%% lighter.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.arcChain.off: Arc chain off: all the charge goes into the main target, about 10%% heavier, hitting one foe only.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.timing: Cast at a foe within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.growth.0: At level %1$s the main hit rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.growth.1: At level %1$s the main hit rises to %2$s, the rush to %3$s blocks, and the flinch chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.preference.ove: On: a longer rush, a higher charge cap and faster build-up and a heavier hit, but a slower wind-up and cooldown and a worse overshoot when it misses. Off: a short, quick ram that is faster and steadier with a lower charge payoff.
worldcombat.skill.zingzap.preference.arc: On: on contact the current jumps to the nearest other foe (settled at 50%% of the main hit, with a flinch chance 60%% of the main hit's), but the main hit is about 10%% lighter. Off: all the charge goes into the main target, about 10%% heavier.
The companion only starts the rush on a threat this close; higher chases a little farther, lower waits until it is right next to the target.
On: the companion prefers a target more than 2 blocks away, since the run-up builds the charge; point-blank gets no bonus and follows the normal melee order.
